Spiced Halloween Pumpkin Bread

Served at: All Hallows' Eve (Halloween)

Makes 1 standard loaf (about 12 slices)Prep 15 minCook 60-70 min

This moist and fragrant pumpkin bread is a quintessential autumn treat, perfectly embodying the spirit of All Hallows' Eve. As pumpkins are a symbol of the season and Halloween, baking this bread fills your home with warm, inviting aromas, making it ideal for sharing with trick-or-treaters or enjoying with a hot drink on a crisp October evening.

Ingredients

  • 1 ½ cups (190g) all-purpose flour
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda
  • ½ teaspoon baking powder
  • ½ teaspoon salt
  • 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  • ½ teaspoon ground nutmeg
  • ¼ teaspoon ground cloves
  • ¼ teaspoon ground ginger
  • 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar
  • ½ cup (100g) packed light brown sugar
  • ½ cup (120ml) vegetable oil
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 cup (240g) pumpkin puree (not pumpkin pie filling)
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Method

  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x5-inch (23x13cm) loaf pan, or line with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and ginger until well combined.
  3. In a separate medium bowl, whisk together the granulated sugar, brown sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, pumpkin puree, and vanilla extract until smooth.
  4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Stir with a spatula until just combined; be careful not to overmix, as this can lead to a tough bread.
  5. Pour the batter evenly into the prepared loaf pan.
  6. Bake for 60-70 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. If the top browns too quickly, you can loosely tent it with aluminum foil during the last 15-20 minutes of baking.
  7. Let the pumpkin bread cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before inverting it onto a wire rack to cool completely before slicing and serving.

Tips

  • For extra texture, fold in ½ cup (60g) chopped pecans or walnuts, or ½ cup (85g) chocolate chips, with the dry ingredients.
  • Ensure you use pure pumpkin puree, not pumpkin pie filling, which contains added spices and sugar.
  • This bread freezes beautifully; wrap cooled loaf tightly in plastic wrap and then foil for up to 3 months.
